YESSS the wait is almost over. September 28. 🤍

And after seeing everything here in Texas, I’m even more excited to share what’s coming.

Beauty by MAKE: Precision Skincare powered by Natural Peptides.

This isn’t just another skincare launch. The entire system was designed around helping support your skin’s natural processes with a combination of natural peptides, plant exosomes, plant stem cells, hydration, antioxidants + barrier-supporting ingredients.

They call it the SPA Method™:
SIGNAL — give the skin the right signals
PRESERVE — help protect the progress
AMPLIFY — create the environment for those signals to work

And the topical system? 😍

✨ REVIVED — Regenerative Peptide Serum
Featuring Sacha Inchi Peptide, Goji Berry Exosomes, green tea, pomegranate, hibiscus, niacinamide + multi-level hyaluronic acid.

✨ REPLENISHED — Polypeptide Stem Cell Emulsion
Featuring pea peptide, teff seed peptide, argan, alpine rose, apple + grape stem cells, ceramides, bakuchiol, squalane, green tea, pomegranate + hibiscus.

What makes me most excited is the whole inside + outside approach we’ve been learning about with this beauty system. It’s not about covering up your skin it’s about supporting it.

I’ve been watching the testing, seeing the results and waiting for the day I could finally say:

SEPTEMBER 28. IT’S HAPPENING. 🔥

If skincare, peptides, healthy aging and feeling amazing in your own skin are your thing, you’re going to want to be on my VIP list before this drops.

Comment BEAUTY or message me “VIP” and I’ll make sure you get all the details. 💗
